## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` is empty (run `make fmt`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, flags, or the wire/API contract changed
      (`README.md`, `docs/`, `api/openapi.yaml`)
- [ ] Security invariants preserved (deterministic-first, fail-closed,
      approvals human-only, receipts request-bound)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
